title: All White
description: Minecraft but it's stripped of its colour!
body:
A challenge to beat Minecraft with no textures and item names.

Inspired by a [Baablu](https://www.twitch.tv/baablu) stream.

## **Known Issues:**
- Water still has colour
- Swamp and Mangrove biome colours still appear on short and tall grass ![Short Grass still has colour](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4f8c370bf7ba7e6af59aa9c0f2446390384b8e3e.png)
- Lily Pad and Vine items still have colour
- All dyeables still has colour
- Tropical Fish changed their body colours to what their pattern colour is
- Sheep become their wool colour
